state.question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.
state.summary: The local-state evidence supports a preparation-to-assembly chain: v4 shows the chef handling a cloth while rice and salmon remain separate and static; v1 shows hands approaching those separate components; v3 shows the salmon slice being moved from the board toward off-screen assembly while rice is shaped; v2 shows rice being pressed onto salmon and then a finished nigiri being held. This supports the chronological order v4 -> v1 -> v3 -> v2.

events.description: Chef in black uniform stands behind counter with rice, wasabi, and salmon. Right hand touches rice mound.
Close-up of hands on wooden board. Left hand near rice, right hand near salmon slice.
A chef in a black uniform stands behind a wooden counter, shaping a piece of salmon nigiri sushi with both hands.
A close-up view of hands pressing rice onto a slice of salmon on a wooden cutting board.
A close-up of hands holding a finished piece of salmon nigiri, with the fish draped over the rice.
A person shapes rice with one hand and handles salmon with the other. The right hand moves the salmon slice from the cutting board to an off-screen location.
events.uncertainty: Exact destination of the salmon slice.

Chef handles a cloth while separate rice and salmon pieces remain static on the cutting board.
events.uncertainty: No assembly or pressing action observed.
